She quit, stayed, and built a small workshop making real packaging from agave fiber and coconut husk. item.title: She Designed Offices for a Decade. Then Bought a Santorini Cave House | A Relaxing Story

Over one slow year she restored it by hand with local masons and a structural engineer named Yannis, and opened it as a tiny three room bed and breakfast above the caldera. item.title: She Sold Fake Skincare. In Byron Bay She Grew the Real Thing | A Relaxing Story
item.description:
